_note: 100 synthetic resume-job pairs for the skills gate (MARKET_STRATEGY 2.6: precision of "Not shown" at least 95%). Every resume, posting and employer is invented; the roles and most skill names are those of the MKT-1D role groups (eval/fixtures/seed/groups.json), referenced by basedOn. Each posting skill carries the state a person reading the resume would give it and a one-line reason. shown: the resume names the skill itself, under any of its usual names and in any script, in its skill list or in a sentence. related: it does not name the skill, and it names a more specific one that shows it (PostgreSQL for "relational databases"). not_shown: neither. The labels were written by the engineer of the check (authored), before the check was run on them, and were not graded by a recruiter. softSkills are listed by the posting and carry no state: a soft skill is never an item of the check.
